invented_facts: Aurora 14 can lower the cloud workstation bill or replace ongoing subscription fees.
Approving pilot units now would allow deployment before the Q1 budget window closes; the spec lists Q4 availability.
Cloud workstations require stable internet for all work, charge monthly fees per user, and keep client drawings behind a firewall.
Engineers can annotate drawings, run simulations, and access project files offline on the Aurora 14.
Data never leaves the device unless the user chooses to sync it, and using the laptop improves security by avoiding public-network transit.
Aurora 14 storage is user-upgradeable; the spec confirms user-upgradeable memory and two M.2 slots, but not user-upgradeable storage.
Waiting until next year necessarily locks in current cloud costs for another year.
notes: All three emails address the requested stages, but emails 1 and 2 exceed 120 words, and email 3 includes an additional request to respond if Q1 has closed. Several cost, deployment, offline-work, and security claims go beyond the attachments.
